name: Dex Expansion (Gen 2-5)
description: Registers National Dex 152-649 as real species, with the Gen 2-5 level-up moves they need and the STEEL / DARK / FAIRY types those moves require. Existence is unconditional and availability is optional, so no setting can ever orphan a species or move a save already knows. MODERN keeps real typings; RETRO GEN 1 retypes onto the original 15 and resolves every modern move to its nearest Gen 1 ancestor.
